about: The Korean Biology Olympiad committee and the Korean Society of Biology Education organize this separate middle-school competition. The official site calls the 2026 sixth edition 중학생생물챌린지, formerly 한국중학생생물대회, and uses Middle School Korea Biology Olympiad in English. It began in 2021, not a high-school KBO selection round. The public download board has no entries and the reference room lists posters and an ID replacement form; no public full examination paper or official solution PDF was found as of 2026-10-30. The official information page publishes an image of two illustrative written-response questions; these are sample questions, not an identified year's actual examination. No paper URLs, solutions or unavailable examination years are invented.
